snippet.title: Superstar Hockey - Hit, Pass, Score, WIN!
snippet.description:
Kick off the new NHL season with an ice-shattering mobile hockey experience, Superstar Hockey on iOS & Android!

This retro sports simulator puts one-touch control of the NHL in your hands, challenging you to hit, pass and score your way to victory. Advance to better leagues for exciting new rewards, including legendary NHL players!

With the start of hockey season comes new playoffs content, packed with exciting rewards, new star cards & offers. Earn prizes and level up your unstoppable hockey team with the new XP system!

Ready to test your skills and race for the Cup? Download Superstar Hockey on Google Play or the App Store today!

PLAY NOW: https://superstar-hockey.onelink.me/oCz3/obpxoxsk
